items.name: .gitattributes
items.description: Normalizes line endings and marks binary files.
items.content:
# Normalize line endings for every text file
* text=auto eol=lf

# Windows scripts keep CRLF
*.bat text eol=crlf
*.cmd text eol=crlf
*.ps1 text eol=crlf

# Binary files: never diff or merge as text
*.png binary
*.jpg binary
*.jpeg binary
*.gif binary
*.ico binary
*.pdf binary
*.zip binary
*.woff binary
*.woff2 binary

# Lockfiles: collapsed in GitHub diffs
package-lock.json linguist-generated=true
yarn.lock linguist-generated=true

items.name: Prettier config
items.description: A sensible Prettier setup for JavaScript projects.

items.name: Self-documenting Makefile
items.description: "make help" lists every task of a Node.js project.
items.content:
# Makefile for a Node.js project. Run "make" or "make help" to list targets.
.DEFAULT_GOAL := help
.PHONY: help install dev test lint format build clean

help: ## List the available targets
	@grep -E '^[a-zA-Z_-]+:.*?## ' $(MAKEFILE_LIST) | awk 'BEGIN {FS = ":.*?## "}; {printf "  %-10s %s\n", $$1, $$2}'

install: ## Install dependencies exactly as in package-lock.json
	npm ci

dev: ## Start the development server
	npm run dev

test: ## Run the test suite
	npm test

lint: ## Check code style
	npx eslint .

format: ## Format every file with Prettier
	npx prettier --write .

build: ## Production build
	npm run build

clean: ## Remove build output and dependencies
	rm -rf dist build coverage node_modules

items.name: pre-commit hook
items.description: Runs Prettier and ESLint on staged files before each commit.
items.content:
#!/bin/sh
# Git pre-commit hook: lints and formats only the staged JavaScript/TypeScript files.
# Install: copy to .git/hooks/pre-commit and run "chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit"
# Skip once (emergencies only): git commit --no-verify

STAGED=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep -E '\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx|mjs|cjs)$')
[ -z "$STAGED" ] && exit 0

echo "pre-commit: checking $(echo "$STAGED" | wc -l | tr -d ' ') staged file(s)"

# shellcheck disable=SC2086
npx --no-install prettier --check $STAGED || {
  echo "pre-commit: run \"npx prettier --write\" on the files above, then stage them again."
  exit 1
}

# shellcheck disable=SC2086
npx --no-install eslint --max-warnings=0 $STAGED || {
  echo "pre-commit: fix the lint errors above before committing."
  exit 1
}

exit 0

items.name: Dependabot config
items.description: Weekly dependency and GitHub Actions updates.
items.content:
# Dependabot: weekly dependency updates. Save as .github/dependabot.yml
version: 2
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: "npm"
    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
      day: "monday"
    open-pull-requests-limit: 10
    groups:
      dev-dependencies:
        dependency-type: "development"
        update-types: ["minor", "patch"]
    commit-message:
      prefix: "deps"

  - package-ecosystem: "github-actions"
    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
    commit-message:
      prefix: "ci"

items.name: Docker Compose dev stack
items.description: App + PostgreSQL + Redis with health checks.
items.content:
# Local development stack: app + PostgreSQL + Redis. Run: docker compose up
services:
  app:
    build: .
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://app:app@db:5432/app
      REDIS_URL: redis://cache:6379
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
      cache:
        condition: service_started

  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: app
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: app
      POSTGRES_DB: app
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - db-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U app -d app"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10

  cache:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"

volumes:
  db-data:

items.name: systemd service
items.description: Keeps a Node.js app running and restarts it on failure.
items.content:
# systemd unit that keeps a Node.js app running and restarts it on failure.
# Save as /etc/systemd/system/app.service, then run:
#   sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl enable --now app
#   journalctl -u app -f    (to follow the logs)
[Unit]
Description=Node.js app
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=www-data
WorkingDirectory=/srv/app
Environment=NODE_ENV=production
Environment=PORT=3000
ExecStart=/usr/bin/node server.js
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=full
PrivateTmp=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

items.name: PostgreSQL backup script
items.description: Compressed dumps with rotation, ready for cron.
items.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# PostgreSQL backup with rotation: keeps the last 7 compressed dumps.
# Usage: DATABASE_URL=postgres://user:pass@host:5432/db ./pg-backup.sh [backup_dir]
# Cron (every day at 03:00): 0 3 * * * DATABASE_URL=... /path/pg-backup.sh /var/backups/pg
set -euo pipefail

BACKUP_DIR="${1:-./backups}"
KEEP=7
: "${DATABASE_URL:?Set DATABASE_URL first}"

mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"
FILE="$BACKUP_DIR/db-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).sql.gz"

echo "Dumping database to $FILE"
pg_dump --no-owner --no-privileges "$DATABASE_URL" | gzip -9 > "$FILE"

# Delete everything older than the newest $KEEP backups
ls -1t "$BACKUP_DIR"/db-*.sql.gz | tail -n +"$((KEEP + 1))" | xargs -r rm --

echo "Done. Backups kept:"
ls -lh "$BACKUP_DIR"/db-*.sql.gz

items.name: Release workflow
items.description: Push a v*.*.* tag: tests run and a GitHub Release is published.
items.content:
# GitHub Actions: when you push a tag like v1.2.3, run the tests and publish
# a GitHub Release with automatically generated notes.
# Save as .github/workflows/release.yml, then: git tag v1.0.0 && git push --tags
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*.*.*"]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
      - name: Create the GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --generate-notes --verify-tag

items.name: GitHub Pages deploy
items.description: The official Actions flow to build and deploy to GitHub Pages.
items.content:
# GitHub Actions: build the site and deploy it to GitHub Pages on every push to main.
# Save as .github/workflows/pages.yml and set Settings > Pages > Source to "GitHub Actions".
name: Deploy to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: dist

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

items.name: Automatic git bisect
items.description: Finds the commit that broke your tests by itself.
items.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Finds the commit that broke your tests with git bisect, automatically.
# Usage: ./find-bad-commit.sh <last-good-commit-or-tag> [test command]
# Example: ./find-bad-commit.sh v1.4.0 "npm test"
set -euo pipefail

GOOD="${1:?Pass the last known good commit or tag}"
TEST_CMD="${2:-npm test}"

if ! git diff --quiet || ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo "Commit or stash your changes first." >&2
  exit 1
fi

git bisect start HEAD "$GOOD"
# Exit code 0 = good, 1-124 = bad, 125 = skip (e.g. the commit does not build)
git bisect run sh -c "$TEST_CMD"
echo
echo "First bad commit:"
git bisect log | grep -m1 "first bad commit" || true
git bisect reset
